Object: 0x1800 Transmit PDO 1 Communication Parameter to all Nodes
Object Code Record
Description This object contains the communication parameters for the PDO the CANopen device is able to transmit.

Sub 0x00
Name Highest sub-index supported
Data Type UNSIGNED8
Access ro
Defaultvalue 5
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x01
Name COB ID
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access rw
Defaultvalue $NODEID+0x180
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x02
Name Transmission Type
Data Type UNSIGNED8
Access rw
Defaultvalue 254
Description Sub-index 0x2 defines the transmission type of the TPDO.
0 .. synchronous (acyclic)
1 .. synchronous (every SYNC)
2 .. synchronous (every 2nd SYNC)
240 .. synchronous (every 240th SYNC)

254 .. event-driven (manufacturer-specific)
255 .. event-driven (profile-specific)
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x03
Name Inhibit Time
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Defaultvalue 0
Description Sub-index 0x03 contains the inhibit time. The time is the minimum interval for PDO
transmission if the transmission type is set to FEh and FF h . The value is defined as multiple of 100 μs. The value of 0 shall disable the inhibit time. The value shall not be changed while the PDO exists (bit 31 of sub-index 01h is set to 0 b ).
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x05
Name Event Timer
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Defaultvalue 1000
Description Sub-index 0x05 contains the event-timer. The time is the maximum interval for PDO
transmission if the transmission type is set to 254 and 255 . The value is defined as multiple of 1 ms. The value of 0 shall disable the event-timer.
PDO Mapping no

1 .. synchronous (every SYNC)
2 .. synchronous (every 2nd SYNC)
240 .. synchronous (every 240th SYNC)

254 .. event-driven (manufacturer-specific)
255 .. event-driven (profile-specific)
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x03
Name Inhibit Time
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Defaultvalue 0
Description Sub-index 0x03 contains the inhibit time. The time is the minimum interval for PDO
transmission if the transmission type is set to FEh and FF h . The value is defined as multiple of 100 μs. The value of 0 shall disable the inhibit time. The value shall not be changed while the PDO exists (bit 31 of sub-index 01h is set to 0 b ).
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x05
Name Event Timer
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Defaultvalue 1000
Description Sub-index 0x05 contains the event-timer. The time is the maximum interval for PDO
transmission if the transmission type is set to 254 and 255 . The value is defined as multiple of 1 ms. The value of 0 shall disable the event-timer.
PDO Mapping no

PDO Mapping optional

Name Operation Hours Count_5
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access rw
Description Total operation hours while maximum cell temperature is above 80°C
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x0b
Name Application ShutDown Timer Value - no Com
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access rw
Description If this counter reaches zero the BMS shuts down. Different conditions in the BMS reset this counter continiously. If none of these conditions is present the BMS will shutdown with a delay which is represented by this counter

Counter is reloaded with 0x2014 0x01

Counter is reloaded with 0x2014 0x01 while any of the following conditions are active:
- Pack Voltage is present
- CAN Charger communication is active
- Discharging current higher than 0x2304 0x0D measured

Unit 1s
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x0c
Name Application ShutDown Timer Value - interaction
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Description If this counter reaches zero the BMS shuts down. Different conditions in the BMS reset this counter continiously. If none of these conditions is present the BMS will shutdown with a delay which is represented by this counter

Counter is reloaded with 0x2014 0x02

Unit 1s
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x0d
Name Application ShutDown Timer Value - undervoltage
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Description If this counter reaches zero the BMS shuts down. Different conditions in the BMS reset this counter continiously. If none of these conditions is present the BMS will shutdown with a delay which is represented by this counter

Unit 1s
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x0e
Name LED Display Timer Value
Data Type UNSIGNED16
Access rw
Description If the BMS is woken by the capacity button this counter indicates how long the BMS stays on and displays the SOC with the LEDs.

If this counter reaches zero the BMS goes in shutdown

Unit 100ms
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x0f
Name Ventilator Disable Timer Value
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access rw

Object: 0x2900 Battery Cycles Count Values
Object Code Array

Sub 0x00
Name Highest sub-index supported
Data Type UNSIGNED8
Access ro
Defaultvalue 9
PDO Mapping no

Sub 0x01
Name Discharge Cycles Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Accumulated total discharge cycles. Every discharge current is accumulated until it reaches the value of the Design Capacity. This condition increments the discharge cycle counter.

Discharge cycle counter multiplied by Design capacity yields the total lifetime discharged capactiy

Capacity is counted outside of the deadband
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x02
Name Discharge Cycles Learning Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Number of learning cycles over lifetime
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x03
Name Discharge Cycles After Learning Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Same logic as 0x2900 0x01 but this counter is reset when a valid learning cylce has been performed
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x04
Name Charge Cycles Completed Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Accumulated total charge cycles. Every charge current is accumulated until it reaches the value of the Design Capacity. This condition increments the charge cycle counter.

Charge cycle counter multiplied by Design capacity yields the total lifetime charge capactiy

Capacity is counted outside of the deadband
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x05
Name Charge Cycles Started Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Counts how many times the battery was charged.
If a charging process charges more than 5% of the Design capacity continiously without idle or discharge in between, this is counted as a battery was charged event and this counter increments

Capacity is counted outside of the deadband

If the battery is charged continiously more than 5% this counter is still only incremented once after the first 5%
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x06
Name Discharge Use Detect Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Counter how many times discharging mode was requested. Every switch from charger present to discharge mode increments this counter
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x07
Name Charge Use Detect Low Temperature Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Counter is incremented when a charger is connected and the temperature is in the low temperature regime

Low temperature regime is detected if the lowest cell temperature is below a threshold

Threshold is defined in 0x3200 0x02

Default 10Â°C

Change of regime during charge does not increment this coutner / Only evaluated at the moment the charger is connected
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x08
Name Charge Use Detect Normal Temperature Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Counter is incremented when a charger is connected and the temperature is in the normal temperature regime

Normal temperature regime is detected if the maximum cell temperature is below 0x2300 0x3 and min cell temperature is above 0x2300 0x2



Default 10-35Â°C

Change of regime during charge does not increment this coutner / Only evaluated at the moment the charger is connected
PDO Mapping optional

Sub 0x09
Name Charge Use Detect High Temperature Count
Data Type UNSIGNED32
Access ro
Description Counter is incremented when a charger is connected and the temperature is in the high temperature regime

High temperature regime is detected if the hgihest cell temperature is above a threshold

Threshold is defined in 0x3200 0x04

Default 35Â°C

Change of regime during charge does not increment this coutner / Only evaluated at the moment the charger is connected
PDO Mapping optional
